api-di.title: A POST request through the small Task API
api-di.summary: A successful first POST /tasks with {"title":"Read"}, starting from the empty in-memory store. This is the lesson’s minimal endpoint path, not every ASP.NET Core middleware stage.

nodes.label: HTTP client
nodes.description: Sends POST /tasks, Content-Type: application/json, and {"title":"Read"}.

nodes.label: Bind request and resolve service
nodes.description: ASP.NET Core binds JSON to TaskRequest and supplies the registered singleton TaskStore.

nodes.label: Validate the title
nodes.description: The endpoint rejects blank titles with 400; Read passes and is trimmed.

nodes.label: TaskStore.Add("Read")
nodes.description: Inside the lock, allocate ID 1 and add TaskItem(1, "Read"). Memory is lost on restart.

nodes.label: 201 Created
nodes.description: The HTTP response includes Location: /tasks/1 and the created item as JSON.

nodes.label: 400 Bad Request
nodes.description: The blank-title branch returns without calling Add.

steps.title: Receive and bind
steps.explanation: For this well-formed JSON request, framework binding supplies TaskRequest. The registered store instance is shared across requests.

steps.title: Check the business input
steps.explanation: The endpoint checks whitespace before changing state. A blank title would take the 400 branch instead.

steps.title: Create under the lock
steps.explanation: Read is valid. The initially empty store allocates ID 1 and appends the item while holding its lock.

steps.title: Return the HTTP result
steps.explanation: Results.Created produces 201, Location: /tasks/1 and the item. A later GET can retrieve it while this application instance retains its memory.

steps.title: Compare the rejected branch
steps.explanation: For {"title":"  "}, the endpoint returns 400. There is no Add call, new item or consumed ID in that branch.

linq.title: LINQ stages and materialization
linq.summary: Where, OrderBy and Select define a deferred in-memory query. ToList triggers enumeration and materializes Pass 75, Pass 90; the arrows show logical data transformations, not eager execution at each operator call.

nodes.description: The source is an in-memory list.

nodes.label: Where >= 60
nodes.description: Define a deferred filter that keeps values at least 60 when enumerated.

nodes.label: OrderBy ascending
nodes.description: Define ascending ordering over the filtered sequence; sorting occurs during enumeration.

nodes.label: Select labels
nodes.description: Define a deferred projection to Pass labels.

nodes.label: ToList
nodes.description: Trigger query enumeration: filter, order and project the source, then store the resulting list.

steps.title: Compose the deferred query
steps.explanation: Calling Where, OrderBy and Select builds a query over scores. These operator calls do not yet enumerate the list; the arrows describe its logical stages.

steps.title: ToList triggers enumeration
steps.explanation: During ToList enumeration, Where keeps 90 and 75, OrderBy yields 75 then 90, and Select produces Pass 75 and Pass 90. This is not a claim that every operator runs eagerly or makes an independent pass.

steps.title: Use the materialized result
steps.explanation: The result list now holds Pass 75 and Pass 90 for display. Mutating the source before enumeration could change a deferred query’s result; ToList stores the values produced by this enumeration.

ef-evolution.title: One transaction around two saves
ef-evolution.summary: The task and audit writes share one transaction. A failure before commit leaves changes uncommitted; the scaffold verifies rollback from a fresh context.

nodes.label: Begin transaction
nodes.description: The example opens an explicit provider transaction.

nodes.label: Save task
nodes.description: First SaveChanges writes the task inside the transaction.

nodes.label: Save audit
nodes.description: Second SaveChanges writes the related audit entry.

nodes.label: Commit
nodes.description: Commit only after both saves succeed.

nodes.label: Roll back
nodes.description: Failure before commit prevents publishing both writes.

nodes.label: Fresh-context check
nodes.description: The guided failed-audit fixture queries task and audit tables from a new context.

steps.title: Keep writes together
steps.explanation: A task save alone does not finish the business operation; the audit still needs to succeed.

steps.title: Commit success
steps.explanation: Both successful saves are committed together by the provider transaction.

steps.title: Verify failure
steps.explanation: The duplicate unique-key audit failure triggers rollback. A new context sees no new task and only the original audit event.

cancellation-budgets.title: Two cancellation sources, one operation
cancellation-budgets.summary: Caller cancellation and the operation budget can reach the awaited work through a linked token. Cancellation must be observed cooperatively.

nodes.label: Caller token
nodes.description: The caller can request cancellation.

nodes.label: Operation budget
nodes.description: The budget can independently request cancellation.

nodes.label: Linked token
nodes.description: The linked source forwards either request.

nodes.label: Awaited operation
nodes.description: Pass the token into an API that observes it.

nodes.label: Boundary classification
nodes.description: An OperationCanceledException handler distinguishes caller cancellation from the internal budget.

steps.title: Combine the sources
steps.explanation: Either source can request stopping; this is not a forced thread abort.

steps.title: Propagate to work
steps.explanation: The actual awaited API must support and observe the token.

steps.title: Classify at the boundary
steps.explanation: The deterministic example cancels the budget and reports Budget cancelled. Keep dependency failures separate.

deploy-operations.title: Release, readiness and recovery
deploy-operations.summary: This follows the lesson commented release outline. Migration compatibility and a recovery plan are prerequisites for safe rollback.

nodes.label: Build and tests
nodes.description: Build and run the relevant tests before release.

nodes.label: Publish
nodes.description: Produce the deployment output.

nodes.label: Reviewed migration
nodes.description: Apply reviewed schema changes through the deployment process.

nodes.label: Start instance
nodes.description: Start the new instance with target configuration.

nodes.label: Readiness
nodes.description: Check readiness in the target environment.

nodes.label: Limited traffic
nodes.description: After readiness succeeds, direct limited traffic and observe error rate and latency.

nodes.label: Restore compatible build
nodes.description: If unhealthy, stop traffic to the new instance and restore a prior compatible build.

steps.title: Prepare the release
steps.explanation: Review migration changes before starting the instance. A code rollback cannot undo a destructive schema change.

steps.title: Gate traffic on readiness
steps.explanation: Startup alone is insufficient; readiness precedes limited traffic.

steps.title: Observe and recover
steps.explanation: An unhealthy instance loses traffic and the prior compatible build is restored according to the runbook.

performance.title: Bounded keyset query
performance.summary: Follow the lesson query only after validating after >= 0 and limit in 1..100. This is a query contract, not a measured speedup.
